from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    full_colors = {row[0] for row in grid if row and all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != background}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if not row or row[0] not in full_colors:
            continue
        first_background = next((i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value == background), len(row))
        if 0 < first_background < len(row) and all(value == row[0] for value in row[:first_background]) and all(value == background for value in row[first_background:]):
            out[r][first_background:] = [1] * (len(row) - first_background)
    return out
'''
